bayts.text: There has appeared none like the Chosen One Muḥammad, in secret or in the open, among the creatures of the Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
He spread Islam for us and erased disbelief, and with sincere counsel he was generous to all.
He leads to Allah, through the outward and the inward, whoever obeys him, at every time.
His service has removed faults from me, and granted me uprightness and purity.
It has become clear to me that the Chosen One is the chief of all who have been preferred as chiefs.
Say: his two feet are above every neck; from him the illustrious have borrowed every merit.
Muḥammad: his like has not come in what has passed, and never shall come.
It is established that our Lord willed no like for him, and so his like has not appeared.
His is the mastery, his the excellence, on the Day of "Am I not (your Lord)?" (Qurʾān 7:172) and at the intercession.
He is the Prophet, the Messenger and the intimate friend; he is the beloved, the imām and the guide.
The Originator (Al-Badīʿ) has kept him free of what is not beauty, and the Most Holy (Al-Quddūs) has guarded him from what is not perfection.
(Certain is) the being of the Prophet, the Select One, Muḥammad, the best of creation, the Chosen with the Self-Sufficient.
